changes: Reduce background memory growth and stuttering from Reputation, guild and community activity, including with addon windows closed.
Reduce memory growth while the Highground window is open with a saved profile, and extra work during busy bounty sharing.
Highground: /hg perf start records 60 seconds of FPS, memory and addon activity. Keep WoW in the foreground; /hg perf shows results and /reload saves the report.
notice: After updating from Highground 2.49.0 or the previous standalone versions, /reload loads these fixes. Fully quit and restart WoW when upgrading from an older release. Keep bundled data addons enabled.
